title: Fine Arts Performing Ensemble Participation Packet and the 2026-27 Ensemble Participation Fee, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Fine Arts registration terms of Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the participation fee posts on the date the parent or guardian submits the signed participation packet, at the amount the 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule sets.

**The family submits the packet.** The packet is the family's own submission: the parent or guardian signs and submits the parent permission, code of conduct and overnight travel permission forms through the district's online activities registration, and the submission records the three forms and posts the participation fee.

- Each of the three forms is recorded as received on the day of submission, dated that day.
- One participation fee entry is posted that day, and the household's amount due on the participation rises by the fee.

## Invocation: `submit_arts_packet_1cf2bbdb`

The family's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_arts_packet_1cf2bbdb` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the parent or guardian) runs it to submit the signed packet.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_participation_id` | reference number of the student's Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation, as returned by the activity participation lookup | identifier |
| `participation_fee_amount` | the participation fee to post, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent (half a cent rounds up); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**What comes back.** On success: `activity_participation_id`; `forms_recorded`, the three form codes recorded; `fee_ledger_id`, the reference number of the new participation fee entry; `participation_fee_amount`, US dollars with 2 decimal places; `submitted_date`, today as YYYY-MM-DD; `status` reading "submitted".

**Error.** A malformed amount returns `status` "error" with a message and records nothing.
